Mixing Tylenol (acetaminophen) and alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally not recommended [Highlight end] ` because both are processed by the liver and combining them can increase the risk of serious liver damage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXdtAczLi54VKTWqsUygznWBJJxm6lNcPDH30wLgzNX1U9Ped2jfB3xvziBsoEqBAcvpE-_wELlLi9UoIG5w_4rtSySoXK6Srm3G1Gf4NpQk5DOUk226ksbEeiFwZD128mFDltGi9xSKaqBnVvl7RYKA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXQI0uJWUv1FLGZPNbPE9DKzyTnnCGjbkGYMc_T-HH-WZuKdCl-IHLUv9zPkO0aZxiRGF2zqhymGYj9XIUGh-P-zV8BaJ73G3txyppyCCtNCNF8lAg2TlbLyqH7rwvUZkCY0nrJU2U_Qc)

As explained on [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXdtAczLi54VKTWqsUygznWBJJxm6lNcPDH30wLgzNX1U9Ped2jfB3xvziBsoEqBAcvpE-_wELlLi9UoIG5w_4rtSySoXK6Srm3G1Gf4NpQk5DOUk226ksbEeiFwZD128mFDltGi9xSKaqBnVvl7RYKA) , you should be careful about timing and amounts since alcohol stays in your system for several hours and taking Tylenol for a hangover still carries interaction risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXdtAczLi54VKTWqsUygznWBJJxm6lNcPDH30wLgzNX1U9Ped2jfB3xvziBsoEqBAcvpE-_wELlLi9UoIG5w_4rtSySoXK6Srm3G1Gf4NpQk5DOUk226ksbEeiFwZD128mFDltGi9xSKaqBnVvl7RYKA)

### Why It Can Be Risky

- **Liver strain:** Breaking down acetaminophen can produce a toxic byproduct (NAPQI) that your liver normally neutralizes using glutathione. Alcohol can increase the enzymes that form this toxin and lower protective glutathione levels, raising the risk of liver injury—especially with heavy drinking, regular alcohol use, or taking high/repeated doses of acetaminophen.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF14xQegcrDdA3efQphTyJQJmRzJZMWGfW8RFeF3HfUhBcziV8JeXTNnU0cnqJtNRe52YT_nOCMC4P7hClt11kpLuM832A40e83cj96or05GlJQgMW1cXP2QDb6qR9OpNXus2nSKJ6vpA_Wz2bhOF6rhF6zwNg7cPC5HN_91CPudM26M3CnHMtCSePxe_y)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXQI0uJWUv1FLGZPNbPE9DKzyTnnCGjbkGYMc_T-HH-WZuKdCl-IHLUv9zPkO0aZxiRGF2zqhymGYj9XIUGh-P-zV8BaJ73G3txyppyCCtNCNF8lAg2TlbLyqH7rwvUZkCY0nrJU2U_Qc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX6CZIfuU93B0LfSBdljm6DMzVDor1HHyYwdThOVFb0PhZCBWR1lenQpcHR_Vn4-bmuCkD0Mrt-OSjWgZB8MJJwmMoY2CYpH8Zzzt8wNoyXCTQRqAQ2jyr1R_ISu6JWCfgpgfefaraSFYGGYF9q30yO6V4HaA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXnKRR6pWCXL7I6QVUTVwjWMpgA3C3BJw6LMs03y2shCxCrpISm6bD6mdqbXGrr1H6TmCoU4fPz5_6NoskEJe8KITw9eCxyRmSQVxJdn8aqXECerXzVKKULayLcqa4ZGew4QI)
- **Hidden acetaminophen:** Acetaminophen is found in many combination cold, flu, sinus, and pain medications, making accidental double-dosing easy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXdtAczLi54VKTWqsUygznWBJJxm6lNcPDH30wLgzNX1U9Ped2jfB3xvziBsoEqBAcvpE-_wELlLi9UoIG5w_4rtSySoXK6Srm3G1Gf4NpQk5DOUk226ksbEeiFwZD128mFDltGi9xSKaqBnVvl7RYKA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXSu0p0wnRZe5KW3PRmGPUmjFeWEbMy7hizWN_gKIyUltkLRaqTEKqJIpf37AphEsroD34ZRv96zM1adR9wgSECSlsahFH454lnFYJ-841laVNmDjpEIAn_K7ZJR5jfXPxEcD4ivU3SAo)
- **Higher-risk groups:** Risk is greater if you drink heavily or daily (such as 3 or more drinks a day), have liver disease or alcohol use disorder, are fasting or malnourished, or exceed recommended daily limits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX6CZIfuU93B0LfSBdljm6DMzVDor1HHyYwdThOVFb0PhZCBWR1lenQpcHR_Vn4-bmuCkD0Mrt-OSjWgZB8MJJwmMoY2CYpH8Zzzt8wNoyXCTQRqAQ2jyr1R_ISu6JWCfgpgfefaraSFYGGYF9q30yO6V4HaA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF14xQegcrDdA3efQphTyJQJmRzJZMWGfW8RFeF3HfUhBcziV8JeXTNnU0cnqJtNRe52YT_nOCMC4P7hClt11kpLuM832A40e83cj96or05GlJQgMW1cXP2QDb6qR9OpNXus2nSKJ6vpA_Wz2bhOF6rhF6zwNg7cPC5HN_91CPudM26M3CnHMtCSePxe_y)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXdMD9vSdbAC1X7y0AxAvjrS9HDtcqlyzvjKvaZcm8NiImUSQN9EVX71IJ331TlMDhVb5Lor3cFU9WN-QzB0IdNd5WzcMICfWcfm1a6usz8xoPZKQAvwyymAnYsOp0f83oSRAII7_FG07Kqm4EgwmOLzAORkdINg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXnKRR6pWCXL7I6QVUTVwjWMpgA3C3BJw6LMs03y2shCxCrpISm6bD6mdqbXGrr1H6TmCoU4fPz5_6NoskEJe8KITw9eCxyRmSQVxJdn8aqXECerXzVKKULayLcqa4ZGew4QI)

### General Safety Precautions

- **Follow dosing limits:** Do not exceed product label limits (often up to 3,000 mg to 4,000 mg in 24 hours for healthy adults who do not drink regularly, and lower if you drink heavily or have liver risks).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF14xQegcrDdA3efQphTyJQJmRzJZMWGfW8RFeF3HfUhBcziV8JeXTNnU0cnqJtNRe52YT_nOCMC4P7hClt11kpLuM832A40e83cj96or05GlJQgMW1cXP2QDb6qR9OpNXus2nSKJ6vpA_Wz2bhOF6rhF6zwNg7cPC5HN_91CPudM26M3CnHMtCSePxe_y)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX6CZIfuU93B0LfSBdljm6DMzVDor1HHyYwdThOVFb0PhZCBWR1lenQpcHR_Vn4-bmuCkD0Mrt-OSjWgZB8MJJwmMoY2CYpH8Zzzt8wNoyXCTQRqAQ2jyr1R_ISu6JWCfgpgfefaraSFYGGYF9q30yO6V4HaA)

If you drink regularly or heavily, ask a doctor before taking acetaminophen.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXQI0uJWUv1FLGZPNbPE9DKzyTnnCGjbkGYMc_T-HH-WZuKdCl-IHLUv9zPkO0aZxiRGF2zqhymGYj9XIUGh-P-zV8BaJ73G3txyppyCCtNCNF8lAg2TlbLyqH7rwvUZkCY0nrJU2U_Qc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXdtAczLi54VKTWqsUygznWBJJxm6lNcPDH30wLgzNX1U9Ped2jfB3xvziBsoEqBAcvpE-_wELlLi9UoIG5w_4rtSySoXK6Srm3G1Gf4NpQk5DOUk226ksbEeiFwZD128mFDltGi9xSKaqBnVvl7RYKA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX6CZIfuU93B0LfSBdljm6DMzVDor1HHyYwdThOVFb0PhZCBWR1lenQpcHR_Vn4-bmuCkD0Mrt-OSjWgZB8MJJwmMoY2CYpH8Zzzt8wNoyXCTQRqAQ2jyr1R_ISu6JWCfgpgfefaraSFYGGYF9q30yO6V4HaA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF16wYy3cNvgbJ_FZWC3JcUE4D4uvkpyTB6ca9vCfFhl6SZ2Qtya-0Qw-OMyMd8BU4Da-SE5vP6ZRu5Noa9zdniYuVy7U_NEXXuqKtSYXHvP5vD6oxQqtHgHKiY4hVgvPuuWCkrRhKweOvsD6X37U6sZhO-5qaea4BAO-xx7cscw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF14xQegcrDdA3efQphTyJQJmRzJZMWGfW8RFeF3HfUhBcziV8JeXTNnU0cnqJtNRe52YT_nOCMC4P7hClt11kpLuM832A40e83cj96or05GlJQgMW1cXP2QDb6qR9OpNXus2nSKJ6vpA_Wz2bhOF6rhF6zwNg7cPC5HN_91CPudM26M3CnHMtCSePxe_y)
- **Watch for warning signs:** Seek prompt medical care if you notice symptoms of liver trouble or overdose, such as yellowing skin or eyes (jaundice), upper-right abdominal pain, dark urine, severe nausea or vomiting, unusual bleeding/bruising, or confusion.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXdMD9vSdbAC1X7y0AxAvjrS9HDtcqlyzvjKvaZcm8NiImUSQN9EVX71IJ331TlMDhVb5Lor3cFU9WN-QzB0IdNd5WzcMICfWcfm1a6usz8xoPZKQAvwyymAnYsOp0f83oSRAII7_FG07Kqm4EgwmOLzAORkdINg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF14xQegcrDdA3efQphTyJQJmRzJZMWGfW8RFeF3HfUhBcziV8JeXTNnU0cnqJtNRe52YT_nOCMC4P7hClt11kpLuM832A40e83cj96or05GlJQgMW1cXP2QDb6qR9OpNXus2nSKJ6vpA_Wz2bhOF6rhF6zwNg7cPC5HN_91CPudM26M3CnHMtCSePxe_y)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESugEBxCJF15-tHWyUoaGyoXqxaOJljQCC3H7ojqJcRGpIM1Jm4ySeDtrxOcyqk2ubeFIH9tHrojsDvTVFgUOZIdwoEQaXf7Unk5xRwyTlTU6asMoOLgTor37zz6ubw2sxbT2-45e8XUWaVsHy8tt17daWsVG8gcJEuhh2PiXtSap2-8kUcLhn10MvA7Ix-fR8XPZJEPyx2-3T7OJZ-m8TXEsUMWEshRMxLtYLlDAEoiq50ShUxMzoRxLdqYc)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1y3I_gwlkPRst69vJZ3k7tMroWJtEWag4ZcznTirzE81xWt1N1TM-AG1IJk2YqH14Vl6MZRMJoGd565Ve1qimORLsFygAHtUdMvOhKwo_8V1BIuRT2HggZrYkLx-HN2sSz9dNJxP-g6Cr1_YGPJHnUY-rYG1y65vXGsDI6P-aGsO)
